name: Daniel Rodriguez
bio:
Daniel's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by attending local stock car races with his family. He initially pursued culinary arts, graduating top of his class. However, he always dreamt of combining his culinary skills with his love for racing. After gaining experience in high-volume catering for large events, he saw an opportunity to bring his expertise to the motorsport world.

Daniel believes that a well-fed team is a high-performing team. He meticulously plans menus, ensuring they are nutritionally balanced and cater to the diverse dietary needs of the Opala Legends crew. He is committed to providing a comfortable and efficient catering service at every race, contributing to the overall success and morale of the team. His pragmatic approach ensures minimal waste and maximum efficiency, making him a valuable asset.

What sets Daniel apart is his ability to adapt to the unique challenges of a mobile catering operation. He thrives under pressure, consistently delivering high-quality meals in demanding environments. His calm demeanor and methodical approach help maintain a sense of order amidst the chaos of race day.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a side part
physical.description: Daniel is of average height with a wiry build, always seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of olive oil, even when it's difficult to source.
Always has a backup plan for every meal, anticipating potential ingredient shortages.
Meticulously labels and dates all food containers, even for the smallest leftovers.
